  • A Engenharia Corporativa é a área estratégica responsável por estabelecer diretrizes técnicas, padronizar práticas de engenharia e garantir que todas as obras e projetos executados em nível nacional sigam padrões elevados de qualidade, segurança, eficiência e conformidade normativa. A área é composta por especialistas dedicados nas disciplinas de Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Civil e Processos, formando um núcleo técnico multidisciplinar que atua como referência para todas as unidades da empresa no Brasil. Seu objetivo central é acompanhar e garantir a correta execução das obras e projetos contratados junto a terceiros, assegurando aderência ao escopo técnico previamente definido pelos especialistas e alinhado às necessidades das unidades operacionais — que são os clientes internos do processo.

Atividades Desenvolvidas

  • Ler e interpretar projetos (arquitetura, estrutural, instalações).
  • Atualizar cronogramas e apoiar o planejamento (datas, marcos, curva S).
  • Realizar levantamentos quantitativos (materiais, medições preliminares).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos (diário de obra, semanal, registros fotográficos).
  • Apoiar análises técnicas de propostas e orçamentos (equalização técnica, comparação de escopo, apoio a compras corporativas).
  • Atualizar bases de dados corporativas (capex, medições, indicadores, portfólio de obras).
  • Dar suporte à elaboração de padrões corporativos (procedimentos, manuais, diretrizes técnicas).
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de projetos nacionais (entrada de demandas, priorização, status, cronograma macro).
  • Auxiliar na criação de relatórios executivos (dashboards, apresentações, análises de performance).
  • Acompanhar contratos corporativos de engenharia e manutenção (vigência, escopo, SLAs, documentação).
  • Apoiar análises de viabilidade técnica e financeira (payback, ROI, estimativas de custo).
  • Organizar e controlar documentação nacional (projetos, ARTs, as built, laudos, inventários).
  • Atuar como suporte técnico às unidades (tirar dúvidas, organizar respostas, padronizar informações enviadas à operação).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior em andamento em Engenharia Civil.
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 6h diárias.
  • Conhecimentos do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos.
  • Conhecimentos de informática e cursos complementares.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Curso técnico profissionalizante.
  • Inglês básico.

Informações adicionais

  • Planejar sonhos: Bolsa Auxílio compatível com o mercado.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica e Wellhub.
  • Alimentação de Qualidade: Ticket Refeição (Matriz RJ).
  • Desenvolvimento: Programa de Desenvolvimento e Universidade Corporativa.
  • Curtir o Aniversário: Folga no mês do aniversário.
  • Outros: Seguro de Vida e benefícios exclusivos.

SUPERGASBRAS

O que faz a gente ser Super?

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

E o que nós fazemos exatamente?

Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.

  • Manage SharePoint structure, file hygiene, and documentation versions

Communications Support

  • Coordinate communication efforts for process improvement updates.

Training and Engagement Support

  • Support creation of training documents, guides, and reference packs.

General Operational Support

  • Track risks, issues, dependencies, and cross‑team actions.
  • Coordinate activities and ensure alignment between teams and consistent updates to project leadership.

Key Internal Relationships

  • Associate Director and Director, Process Optimization; functional teams across the Organization; project teams; administrative support teams

Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

The Ideal Candidate (essential Criteria)

  • 2–4 years in project coordination, operations, PMO support, or process coordination.
  • Demonstrated documentation discipline: trackers, logs, SOPs, workflow docs
  • Data proficiency in (tables, charts, simple dashboards). PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint
  • Experience coordinating multi‑stakeholder workflows with follow‑through.

Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.

Excellent benefits and perks to promote well‑being and a healthy work‑life balance, including:

  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
  • Employer‑paid health insurance *and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.

A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Description Of The Organization

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.

Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):

  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands‑on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.
  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.
  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead
description:
Who we are

At Fortis Games we aspire to make great games that bring people together while redefining how game companies work. We believe in building a sense of belonging through our games, their communities, and how we operate and treat each other. Through our game communities, we will create powerful connections and lasting memories. We will foster a culture of diversity, equity and belonging where together our diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds impact the games we make.

About the Role

As a Staff Technical Artist at Fortis Games, you will take a leading role in shaping the technical foundations of our art pipelines across multiple projects. You’ll independently design and implement complex solutions, introduce new processes that drive creative and technical work forward, and partner with senior leaders across art, design, and engineering to ensure seamless collaboration.

This role goes beyond supporting production—it’s about building scalable systems, leading senior ICs, and facilitating cross‑functional communication so that our teams can deliver innovative, high‑quality experiences efficiently. You will serve as both a technical leader and mentor, helping Fortis push the boundaries of art and technology in mobile gaming.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Architect and oversee scalable art pipelines across multiple projects, ensuring consistency, technical efficiency, and creative flexibility.
  • Design and implement new tools and processes that accelerate iteration, improve workflow efficiency, and enhance collaboration between art, design, and engineering teams.
  • Introduce and evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., procedural systems, AI‑assisted pipelines, real‑time rendering) to keep Fortis at the forefront of technical innovation.
  • Mentor senior ICs , translating strategy into actionable tasks and fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Facilitate cross‑functional communication , aligning art, engineering, and production workflows to keep goals clear and achievable.
  • Oversee multiple technical workflows simultaneously , balancing near‑term production needs with long‑term scalability.
  • Elevate performance and visual quality through advanced optimization techniques for mobile platforms (e.g., draw calls, shaders, polycounts, overdraw).
  • Champion collaboration and knowledge sharing by modeling best practices and influencing cross‑functional initiatives at the organizational level.

Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

The Opportunity:

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become anAI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

title: Service Engineer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Create Alert

MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional information

Do you have questions regarding the role? Please contact Vinicius Lima, Operations Superintendent at

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English through our recruitment portal. Unfortunately we do not consider CVs sent via email.

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

Curte tecnologia,inovação e tem agilidade no DNA?

Na Spassu, estamos com um projeto incrível no ar — e ele está prontíssimo para receber profissionais com aquele algo a mais.

Se você é Engenheiro de SMS, tem perfil inquieto, gosta de aprender e crescer junto com uma empresa que valoriza ideias novas, vem com a gente!

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para expandir seus conhecimentos, aplicar seu talento e fazer parte de algo realmente significativo, inscreva-se e venha transformar com a Spassu!

Os CV's permanecerão em poder da empresa enquanto perdurar o processo seletivo e pelo período adicional de 6 meses, para eventuais processos seletivos futuros, em atendimento a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES: Atuar em projetos designados nas atividades de levantamento e gerenciamento de requisitos Segurança Meio ambiente e Saúde (SMS).

  • Atuar na divulgação das orientações de SMS às gerências e em contratadas; no levantamento, análise e implementação de ações corretivas de segurança no trabalho; a fiscalização no atendimento aos requisitos legais pelas contratadas; no levantamento, análise e disponibilização de dados de indicadores de SMS, incluindo a disponibilização e manutenção em sistemas corporativos; no atendimento às auditorias de SMS e Gestão Ambiental, e investigações de acidentes/incidentes; tecnicamente fiscalização de contratos no cumprimento de requisitos contratuais de SMS e de Gestão Ambiental;
  • Planejar, executar, monitorar e realizar análise crítica de inspeções com foco em gestão ambiental de obras e atividades industriais;
  • Apoiar nas vistoria de órgãos reguladores (p. ex. INEA, MP etc.) e realizar acompanhamento do atendimento a notificações recebidas;
  • Realizar LV de SMS e gestão ambiental nas contratadas;
  • Elaborar relatórios, pareceres técnicos ou apresentações sobre SMS e Gestão Ambiental, tais como: relatório fotográfico de inspeção de campo, plano de ação de SMS, apresentações sobre SMS, relatórios para órgãos reguladores externos e para áreas corporativas, acompanhamento de condicionantes etc;
  • Utilizar as ferramentas de gestão ambiental do cliente, tais como Avaliação de Práticas Ambientais (APA), Audicomp, SIGEM, SISPEN, SALV2, AUDICOMP, SISIN, DDSMS, DATAHIDRO, SCR, SMSNet e SIGA;
  • Avaliar e comentar documentos de SMS para Gestão Ambiental, emitidos tanto pela cliente como por contratadas, com o resumo do respectivo parecer (em ADC ou outro modelo definido pela fiscalização);
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas, elaborando as minutas previamente para avaliação da Petrobras, com as principais informações quanto aspectos técnicos e des desempenho de SMS da contratada ou consolidado da gerência.

Requisitos

Graduação de nível superior, bacharelado, em Engenharia de Floresta ou Ambiental ou Engenharia ou Arquitetura com pós-graduação na área SMS.

Certificação não requerida.

Experiência desejável: 10 anos em Execução das atividades descritas na indústria de Óleo e Gás ou Indústria da Construção ou Gestão de SMS.

Conhecimento em Pacote Office e Auditoria em Sistemas de Gestão.

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou‑se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país.

Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem‑estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente? Junte-se ao Grupo Profarma!

description:

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil | Workplace Type: Hybrid

About The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Partner Development & Activation Lead to drive strategic partnerships within the pharmaceutical, governmental health, and insurance sectors. This role is pivotal in expanding our reach and impact by fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders, activating hospital partnerships, and engaging health professionals and patients. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in healthcare, business development, and digital engagement, with a proven track record of managing complex partnerships and driving operational excellence. You will be responsible for leading relationship development, identifying and closing high-impact partnership opportunities, and ensuring the successful activation of our solutions within hospital settings. This role requires a strategic thinker with the ability to execute in a fast-paced environment, coupled with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead relationship development and expansion with key partners in the pharma, government, and insurance sectors
  • Identify, pursue, and close high-impact partnership opportunities across relevant sectors
  • Act as the key local representative in strategic partner discussions and contract execution
  • Develop joint value propositions and co-branded engagement strategies tailored to each partner's needs
  • Oversee operations and performance improvement initiatives at hospital sites
  • Coordinate with hospital staff, KOLs, and marketing teams for training, communication tools, and symposia
  • Supervise Elfie coordinators and ambassadors on-site, ensuring effective implementation of programs
  • Ensure application readiness and compliance in local markets, adhering to all regulatory requirements
  • Conduct user interviews and integrate feedback into feature updates to enhance user experience
  • Build and nurture communities of advocates to promote our solutions and drive adoption

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years' experience across Pharmaceutical, Consulting, and Startup/Digital Health environments
  • Proven track record managing complex partnerships in healthcare or life sciences
  • Strong Business Development and stakeholder engagement skills across public and private sectors
  • Experience in developing and executing partnership strategies that drive business growth
  • Solid understanding of the healthcare landscape, including regulatory requirements and market dynamics
  • Digital marketing and/or consumer engagement experience is a plus
  • Fluency in both English and French (required)
  • Strategic thinking paired with operational follow-through in fast-paced settings
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred

Additional Information

This is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing company at the forefront of healthcare innovation. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as the opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of patients and healthcare professionals. The role is based in Montreal, Canada, and will require occasional travel to partner sites and industry events. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals. If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for healthcare and a proven track record of success in partnership development, we encourage you to apply. Join us in our mission to transform healthcare through innovative solutions and strategic partnerships.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar dashboards, relatórios analíticos e apresentações executivas que conectem indicadores de pessoas às decisões estratégicas.
  • Planejar e implementar iniciativas com foco em competências futuras e aplicação prática no negócio.

We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced engineering leader to join our team and lead the development of software solutions with both front-end and back-end components. Your team will be responsible for delivering products that support internal operations and drive our market-facing initiatives. You’ll be part of an international environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to shape and evolve our platform and digital experiences. We value teamwork and embrace a culture of ownership—our engineers are both autonomous and accountable for their deliverables. We are deeply customer-focused and committed to building software that creates real value for our users and the business.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development support.
  • Own the architecture and development of full-stack applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployments and high system reliability.
  • Design and implement scalable backend services leveraging AWS services.
  • Drive best practices in coding standards, code reviews, and system architecture.
  • Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure on-time delivery.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Engineer or similar role, with at least 2 years in a team lead or management capacity.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (DocumentDB, Lambda, EKS, API Gateway, S3, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and working with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
  • A strong advocate for clean code, tests, scalability, and performance optimization.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer‑centric company on earth. To get there, the Global Engineering Services Launch (Launch) team needs exceptionally talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. The key to this mission is strategic, large scale project management initiatives that will allow us to scale our organization for the future in an extraordinary manner.

The Launch team is seeking a qualified candidate to solve the complex challenges of progressive innovation to drive efficiencies at operational benchmark rates. We are looking for a customer‑obsessed Program Manager with proven program management experience and a strong track record of delivering results to own and execute highly strategic launches, in addition to driving multiple complex projects across one or more programs. If you are looking for an environment where you can drive business innovation amidst various levels of ambiguity, this is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing team within Amazon!

Key Responsibilities

  • Gains trust and consistently delivers results;
  • Is results driven, hard‑working, and a creative person who loves solving challenging problems;
  • Works backwards from the customer to scope and define program requirements and critical milestones;
  • Can effectively navigate ambiguous situations without heavily relying on direct support from their leader;
  • Is able to demonstrate a high level of ownership to drive multiple time‑sensitive action items simultaneously through multiple business groups;
  • Is able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines whilst maintaining a customer focus;
  • Is comfortable collaborating and influencing team members, working with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis;
  • Has the ability to partner to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year;
  • Optimizes cross‑team processes that improve team efficacy and delivery;
  • Has the technical aptitude to quickly grasp complex technical issues and communicate directly with technical teams;
  • Takes ownership and accountability for programs, while maintaining the ability to ask for help, and escalates issues and problems as necessary to keep programs on track;
  • Is comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and operating in a rapidly evolving and changing landscape;
  • Is willing to drive into the details and leverage high judgment and gut instinct;
  • Communicates effectively to all stakeholders related to a launch or program/project.
  • Extensive travel, up to 50%.

A Day in the Life

  • Effectively managing the Road to Launch process, which ultimately allows for a building hand‑off that passes operational readiness testing and sets the operations team up for success;
  • Managing day‑to‑day relationships with multiple Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Sort Centers (SCs), and Delivery Stations (AMZL);
  • Coordinating GES and Operations stakeholders to exceed Amazon standards for the launch of new sites or expansions of existing buildings in order to achieve operational success;
  • Deep diving existing processes to identify defects or opportunities for process improvements;
  • Compiling, managing, and reporting on weekly project metrics;
  • Driving multiple projects to optimize, standardize, and/or improve processes within and outside of launch.

About The Team

Have you ever had an opportunity to be a member of a team that is tasked with solving a huge customer need through disruptive, innovative technology, reinventing an industry? You can expect all the challenges and benefits of a high‑profile business: wide‑open space for process improvement and innovation, and a high caliber, high performance team, within a fast‑paced environment. This role will require a willingness to dive deep into the details, proactively solve problems, leverage thorough judgment and intuitive thinking to strategically grow a program and always obsess over customers. Everyone on the team wears multiple hats, however ownership of the customer experience is always prioritized!

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in program or project management;
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements;
  • Experience in driving end‑to‑end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership;
  • Fluent Portuguese and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in driving process improvements;
  • Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field;
  • Fluent in French, Polish, Arabic, Spanish, Chinese, Turkish, Afrikaans or Zulu.

Atuar como o elo estratégico e orquestrador da cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo a governança dos processos de planejamento e a interface produtiva entre os principais stakeholders (Marketing, Comercial, Financeiro e Operações). O foco principal é assegurar o cumprimento do nível de serviço e a disponibilidade de estoque, atuando como um PMO de lançamentos e PLV para garantir que a estratégia de negócio se traduza em execução operacional impecável.

Gestão de Stakeholders e S&OP:Liderar fóruns de discussão com as áreas de Marketing e Comercial para alinhar a demanda e a estratégia de abastecimento, influenciando decisões que equilibrem o nível de serviço e a saúde do estoque.

Governança de Processos (PMO):Atuar como PMO dos ciclos de planejamento, garantindo que todos os marcos ( milestones ) de lançamentos e renovações de catálogo sejam respeitados pelas áreas parceiras.

Visibilidade 360º de Lançamentos:Consolidar e reportar o status de prontidão de novos produtos, antecipando riscos de ruptura ou atrasos de chegada e propondo planos de contingência robustos.

Gestão Estratégica de PLV e Brindes:Coordenar o planejamento e o fluxo de materiais de visibilidade (PLV) e produtos livres de venda, garantindo que a execução no ponto de venda esteja sincronizada com as campanhas de marketing.

Arbitragem e Tomada de Decisão:Liderar as negociações com o Intercompany para antecipações, cancelamentos ou priorização de embarques em cenários de restrição ou aceleração de vendas.

Análise de Desempenho e Fill Rate:Gerir os indicadores críticos (KPIs) da área, como Fill Rate, OOS (Out of Stock) e níveis de Bad Stock, transformando dados em insights acionáveis para a diretoria.

Eficiência Operacional:Identificar e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua na cadeia, buscando redução de custos e otimização de processos de fluxo de estoque sobressalente.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Ferramentas:Excel Avançado e proficiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI é essencial para garantir a visibilidade solicitada).
  • Sistemas:Experiência com ERPs (preferencialmente SAP) e softwares de planejamento (APO/IBP).
  • Idiomas:Inglês avançado para interface constante com o time internacional.
  • Experiência:Sólida trajetória em Supply Chain, preferencialmente com passagens por planejamento de demanda ou suprimentos e gestão de projetos/processos.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Visão Holística e Estratégica:Capacidade de enxergar além do dado operacional, entendendo o impacto do planejamento no P&L da companhia.
  • Resiliência e Agilidade:Conforto em trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos com mudanças rápidas de prioridade (típico de lançamentos e mercado de beleza).

title: Engenheiro de Análise Oceânica III
description:
Quem somos

A Longitude Engineering, parte do ABL Group, é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia especializada nos setores marítimo, naval, energia, offshore e renováveis.

Atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade.

No Brasil, nossa equipe trabalha de forma integrada com times internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

Missão

Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

Visão

Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade técnica, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Valores

  • Safety First – Segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical Excellence – Qualidade e precisão técnica
  • Collaboration – Trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança
  • Innovation – Melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & Transparency – Ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Análise Oceânica Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de análises técnicas e modelagens numéricas no departamento de Engenharia Oceânica da Longitude.

Este profissional participará de estudos de engenharia relacionados a hidrodinâmica, sistemas de ancoragem, instalações submarinas e operações marítimas , contribuindo para a execução segura e eficiente de projetos offshore.

A posição envolve a realização de simulações computacionais, análise de resultados, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e suporte técnico a operações offshore , com eventual participação em atividades embarcadas ou acompanhamento de operações quando necessário.

O profissional atuará em um ambiente técnico e multidisciplinar, interagindo com diferentes disciplinas de engenharia e colaborando em projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver análises de sistemas de ancoragem para unidades offshore (FPSO, plataformas e embarcações).
  • Realizar modelagens e simulações numéricas utilizando softwares como OrcaFlex e OrcaWave .
  • Avaliar condições ambientais, carregamentos e comportamento de sistemas submarinos com base em dados meteocean .
  • Conduzir análises hidrodinâmicas relacionadas ao comportamento de embarcações e equipamentos offshore.
  • Automatizar processos de análise e tratamento de dados utilizando Python quando aplicável.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e documentação de engenharia.
  • Dar suporte técnico a operações marítimas e subsea quando necessário.
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de engenharia offshore.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de metodologias e ferramentas de análise.

Requisitos

  • ✔ Graduação em Engenharia Naval, Oceânica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas .
  • ✔ Experiência com modelagem e simulação no software OrcaFlex .
  • ✔ Experiência em análises de sistemas de ancoragem, linhas ou instalação submarina .
  • ✔ Capacidade de interpretação de resultados de simulações e elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • ✔ Inglês intermediário para leitura técnica e comunicação profissional.
  • ✔ Experiência prévia em projetos de engenharia offshore.

Diferenciais

  • ⭐ Experiência em hidrodinâmica aplicada ao movimento de embarcações .
  • ⭐ Experiência com operações marítimas ou engenharia operacional offshore .
  • ⭐ Conhecimento em análise de linhas, cabos, risers ou lançamento de equipamentos submarinos .
  • ⭐ Conhecimento em normas e regulatórios como DNV, ABS, API 2SK ou CSS Code .
  • ⭐ Experiência com softwares como Rhino, HydroD, OrcaWave, Lashcon, Inventor ou Optimoor .
  • ⭐ Experiência com outros softwares de análise hidrodinâmica.

Habilidades técnicas

  • Modelagem e simulação offshore utilizando OrcaFlex .
  • Análise de sistemas de ancoragem e linhas submarinas.
  • Interpretação de resultados de simulações hidrodinâmicas.
  • Avaliação de condições ambientais (meteocean).
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos de engenharia.
  • Programação em Python para automação de análises.
  • Conhecimento em hidrodinâmica aplicada a operações offshore.

Habilidades comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico .
  • Autonomia para conduzir análises técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e trabalho em equipe.
  • Proatividade na busca por soluções de engenharia.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes técnicos.
  • Capacidade de orientar estagiários e engenheiros júnior.

Como é trabalhar na Longitude

Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e multicultural.

Interação constante com equipes e projetos internacionais.

Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e crescimento dentro do grupo.

Participação em projetos relevantes nos setores marítimo, offshore e de energia.

title: Statistician — Time-Series Insights Writer (AI Training)
description:
We’re seeking Statisticians with strong English writing skills to join our Deep Research for Forecasting project. In this role, you will review time-series plots (a quantity of interest over time) along with brief contextual descriptions, then identify the most meaningful patterns in the data and produce concise, well-reasoned causal chains explaining what likely drove those patterns.

Your work will help create high-quality tasks used to train and evaluate AI systems on forecasting-related reasoning. You will focus on distinguishing signal from noise, articulating plausible mechanisms (root cause → intermediate drivers → observed time-series impact), and writing explanations that are clear, grounded, and useful for downstream model training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create Forecasting Training Tasks: Given a time-series plot and short description, identify the most important patterns (trend, seasonality, regime changes, outliers, step changes, cyclical behavior, variance shifts) and document them clearly.
  • Write Causal Chains: Produce concise causal narratives that explain patterns from root cause → mechanism → observable time-series effect, prioritizing the most meaningful drivers and avoiding generic explanations.
  • Ensure Clarity & Usefulness for AI Training: Write structured, high-signal explanations that are easy to evaluate, minimizing ambiguity and making assumptions explicit when necessary.
  • Maintain Consistency & Quality: Follow project guidelines and rubrics to ensure outputs are accurate, coherent, and comparable across many examples.
  • Weekly Commitment: 10 hours/week

Your Profile

  • You have an educational and/or professional background in Statistics or a closely related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science).
  • Proficient in time-series analysis and forecasting (e.g., trend/seasonality, structural breaks, anomalies, volatility shifts, lag effects).
  • Excellent English writing skills with a clear, structured, concise style.
  • Strong analytical judgment and ability to interpret data visualizations with precision.
  • Comfortable forming plausible causal explanations while clearly separating evidence from assumptions.
  • Optional: Domain knowledge in one or more of the following: Healthcare; Climate/oceanography; Economics & finance; Cloud operations; Transportation.

description:
ACES Process Manager - AMZL BR, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As an ACES Process Manager, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) at Amazon Logistics (AMZL). We are Amazon's last mile delivery arm, delivering packages and smiles to our customers every day.

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. You are the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you identify with having a disability, or other support need, please let us know if an accommodation/adjustment would be beneficial to you during the application and hiring process. You may also reach the team directly by visiting this page:

Key job responsibilities

  • Being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
  • Leading process integration efforts at our Delivery Stations (DS);
  • Leading Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma tools like Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
  • Owning and managing change on a granular level;
  • Performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
  • Work with teams both Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers;

A day in the life

You will be working closely with all AMZL teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:

  • Station Ops;
  • Last Mile team/Delivery Service Providers (DSP);
  • Learning;
  • Finance;
  • HR;
  • Loss Prevention.

You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.

About the team

Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) is a team of highly qualified individuals responsible for the quality, productivity, safety, and speed of Amazon Operations. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise on all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree;
  • Data-oriented approach, using KPIs to measure performance;
  • Availability for travel;
  • Experience with Lean Six Sigma;
  • Experience driving projects to improve operations and support-related processes;
  • Advanced English;

Preferred Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree;
  • Experience in project management;
  • Experience in operational logistics/supply chain, manufacturing, transportation, general management or an engineering role;
  • Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments;

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Corretor de Imóveis
description:
Maximize seus ganhos com o modelo mais disruptivo do mercado!

Diferentemente das imobiliárias tradicionais, na BR Estate nós não ficamos com uma porcentagem da sua comissão. Nosso foco é oferecer a infraestrutura jurídica e de marketing para que você receba o valor justo pelo seu trabalho.

  • Independência e rateio justo da Comissão: Em todas as transações sempre haverá 2 corretores/imobiliárias diferentes: um representando o vendedor ("Corretor de Venda") e outro representando o comprador ("Corretor de Compra"), cada um ficando com 50% da comissão.
  • Modelo único: Quando ocorre uma venda, descontamos no sucesso a Taxa de Operação, de 0,5% do valor do Imóvel (com valor mínimo de 3 e máximo de 6 salários mínimos); e, a Taxa de Marketing, de R$250,00 por lead qualificado recebido.
  • Venda mais e ganhe indicando imóveis: Ao indicar imóveis à BR Estate, nós direcionamos para você os leads compradores gerados a partir desse imóvel; e, quando esse imóvel for vendido, você ganha metade da comissão do Corretor de Venda.
  • Faça a BR Estate crescer e ganhe mais por isso: O Corretor Associado que indicar outros corretores para se associar à BR Estate, ganha 25% da Taxa de Operação a cada transação dos corretores indicados.
  • Trabalhe com total autonomia! Sem presença obrigatória no escritório. Sem reuniões obrigatórias. Sem volumes obrigatórios de prospecções ou captações. Sem gerentes e diretores. Negociação de descontos a critério exclusivo dos corretores envolvidos. Time de advogados para fechamento das vendas à disposição dos Corretores Associados.

Perguntas e respostas

  • Fechei 3 vendas: um imóvel de R$800K, outro de R$1,6MM e outro de R$2,4MM. Como fica a Taxa de Operação? Se as comissões forem de 5%, no imóvel de R$800.000,00, você ganha R$20.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação no piso de R$4.863,00; no de R$1.600.000, você ganha R$40.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação de R$8.000,00; no de R$2.400.000, você ganha R$60.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação no teto de R$9.726,00;
  • Para a cobrança da Taxa de Marketing, o que é um lead qualificado? Para leads compradores, lead qualificado é o cliente com visita realizada, presencial ou remota (leads enviados por engano, tais como clientes de aluguel, "vender para comprar" e corretores não são cobrados); para leads vendedores, lead qualificado é cliente que tenha o seu imóvel efetivamente publicado no site da BR Estate.
  • Se eu prospectar o cliente, comprador ou vendedor, como funciona? Esse cliente não será contabilizado para a cobrança da Taxa de Marketing.
  • Se meu cliente comprador fechar um imóvel que eu mesmo indiquei à BR Estate? Nesse caso, você ganha a sua comissão como Corretor de Compra, e ainda ganha metade da comissão do Corretor de Venda.
  • Posso fechar uma parceria com outra imobiliária/corretor? Deve! Parcerias são mais que bem vindas e não afetam a cobrança das taxas.
  • Quero anunciar imóveis através da BR Estate, porém sem passar o contato do proprietário. Posso? Sim, porém nesse caso você atuará exclusivamente como Corretor de Venda e não receberá os leads compradores.
  • É obrigatório estar inscrito no CRECI? Sim.
  • A BR Estate exige exclusividade? Não. O pagamento das taxas à BR Estate somente é devido se o lead tiver sido gerado pela BR Estate ou se o corretor da outra parte também for associado à BR Estate.
  • Como funciona o pagamento das Taxas de Operação e Marketing à BR Estate? Elas serão pagas diretamente pelos clientes e abatidas da comissão devida ao Corretor Associado.
  • Qual o escopo da BR Estate no pós-vendas? Elaboração do compromisso de compra e venda, análise das certidões e encaminhamento para o cartório de notas e/ou instituição financeira responsável pela conclusão jurídica do negócio, salvo se os clientes exigirem conduzir o fechamento do negócio com assessores próprios.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement
description:
Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocatio[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of the North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD).

The RU's scope includes condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Your primary role is to provide proactive maintenance support, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, and overseeing rotating equipment overhaul activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition-based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes of failures and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, such as American Petroleum Institute (API), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM, for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as maintenance cost reduction, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR).

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 15 years of experience in reliability/rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Hold a vibration analyst certificate Cat‑III.
  • Understand industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and aid in technical evaluations of new equipment.

Job Summary

At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world's biggest companies' bug bounty programs.

  • A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company's security program but potentially on hundreds.

title: Research Geophysicist
description:
Posting Start Date: 3/13/26

Field of Work: Geoscience / Geophysics

TGS provides scientific data and intelligence to the global energy sector, enabling energy for all by unlocking vital, data‑driven solutions and knowledge. Through an extensive and diverse energy data library, advanced analytics, cloud‑based applications, and specialized services, we work in a way that is Passionate, Results‑Driven, Collaborative, and Responsible.

Serves as a Research Geophysicist within the Rio de Janeiro R&D team, focusing on the acceleration and automation of the seismic processing lifecycle. This role is a key technical bridge, working in daily collaboration with Data Scientists to find the right blend of conventional signal processing and physics‑based techniques with integrating geophysical first principles into AI‑driven workflows. The primary objective is to develop and implement innovative algorithms for seismic processing that significantly reduce turnaround time while maintaining or enhancing the rigorous standards of geophysical QC.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine geophysical algorithms with a specific focus on automation.
  • Partner closely with Data Scientists to design ML and hybrid workflows that combine traditional signal‑processing and physics‑based techniques with ML‑based solvers.
  • Design automated, objective QC metrics that leverage geophysical attributes to validate the integrity of AI‑processed data.
  • Identify bottlenecks in traditional processing sequences and propose accelerated alternatives using high‑performance computing (HPC) or GPU‑optimized kernels.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, domain experts, and cross‑functional teams on framing ML based solutions.
  • Support the translation of research ideas into scalable production solutions and workflows.
  • Participate in external research activities, publications, or technical forums.
  • Seismic Theory: Deep understanding of wave propagation, signal processing (F‑K, Tau‑P, Curvelet), and inversion theory.
  • Processing Fluency: Hands‑on experience with the seismic processing sequence (from field tapes to migration) and an understanding of where “human‑in‑the‑loop” delays occur.
  • Technical Collaboration: Works effectively within multi‑lead, interdisciplinary environments.
  • Professional Maturity: Operates independently on complex technical problems while seeking alignment when appropriate.

Qualifications:

  • PhD (or MSc with strong applied or research experience) in Geophysics, Physics or a related field.
  • Demonstrated expertise in seismic processing through research, applied projects, or open‑source contributions.
  • Strong programing skills with proficiency in Python is required; experience with C++ for performance‑critical seismic kernels is a significant advantage.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate complex geophysical concepts to non‑geophysicists (data scientists and software engineers), as well as explaining new ideas to processing geophysicists and customers.

If you meet the qualifications and are passionate about contributing to our team, we encourage you to submit your application by04/13/2026.
