title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go‑to‑market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud‑related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

Role Entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical’s global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross‑functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive‑level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long‑term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What We Are Looking For In You

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data‑driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in‑depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to Have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What We Offer Colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

The Fiscal Compliance Supervisor leads and oversees all tax and fiscal compliance activities for Brazil Operations. Responsibilities include reviewing tax calculations and ensuring the timely submission of all required declarations at the federal, state, and municipal levels, as well as filings with BACEN, IBGE, and other regulatory or statistical entities. This role safeguards full compliance, maintains good standing certifications, and ensures adherence to applicable legislation, special tax or customs regimes, and customer contract requirements. The position partners closely with Management and Statutory Accounting, Corporate Tax, Treasury, Intercompany, Supply Chain (Logistics and Procurement), and HR (Payroll and Employment Tax) to ensure accurate tax treatment and compliance across key processes, including equipment movement, payroll burdens, and PIT (IRRF) obligations. The role also manages outsourced service providers, supports audits and inspections, and leads the local fiscal compliance sub team in applying best practices and meeting all statutory deadlines.

Descrição do Cargo

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Tax & Fiscal Compliance Execution - Review and validate federal, state, and municipal tax calculations (IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IBS, CBS, IS, IPTU, etc.). Ensure the timely submission of all statutory declarations (SPEDs, DCTF, EFDs, DIRF equivalent filings, municipal returns, and nota fiscal issuance/collection). Coordinate regulatory filings with the IRS, BACEN, IBGE, and other government or statistical entities. Maintain full compliance with legislation, special tax or customs regimes (e.g., REPETRO and specific ICMS treatments), and customer contract obligations.
  • Cross Functional Compliance Support - Partner with Supply Chain to ensure compliant equipment, goods, and asset movement, including ICMS compliance, nota fiscal issuance, and proper supporting documentation. Support HR in payroll tax compliance, including social burdens (INSS and FGTS) and PIT/IRRF obligations. Collaborate with Management and Statutory Accounting teams on tax accounting in corporate and local ledgers, including P&L provisioning and actuals, balance sheet reconciliations, and budget/forecast preparation for General Taxes. Work with Corporate Tax, Treasury, Legal and Intercompany teams to ensure correct tax treatment across all business processes.
  • Governance, Controls & Risk Management - Maintain internal controls related to fiscal compliance and tax reporting. Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely adjustments to internal processes. Participate in Tax Committees (Tax Reform, Optimization/Savings Projects, ABESPETRO). Safeguard good standing certifications and adherence to compliance requirements across all regulatory bodies.
  • Audit, Inspection & Authority Liaison - Manage responses to tax audits, fiscal inspections, official notices, and inquiries from authorities at all government levels. Coordinate documentation, supporting analyses, and interactions with external auditors and tax advisors.
  • Team Leadership & Vendor Oversight - Lead, mentor, and develop the Brazil fiscal compliance sub team. Oversee outsourced compliance and advisory service providers to ensure proper fiscal documentation (e.g., nota fiscal) retrieval, accuracy, quality, and adherence to cut off dates and tax calendar deadlines. Promote best practices, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement. Recruit, coach, and develop assigned personnel.
  • Perform miscellaneous tasks as required, including the preparation of slide presentations for senior management and other stakeholders' reviews.

Education

  • Minimum Required: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Law, or related field.
  • Preferred Level: Bachelor’s degree with Post‑Graduate specialization or MBA in Taxation, Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum Required: 5+ years of experience in fiscal compliance and accounting operations within Brazil, including routine tax reporting, statutory filings, and tax accounting responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Preferred Level: Supervisory experience in a multi‑entity or multi‑country financial reporting environment, with exposure to corporate‑level tax, treasury, and compliance processes.

Skills

  • Minimum Required: Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; solid bookkeeping foundation; working knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS and Brazilian statutory accounting requirements; strong understanding of local fiscal and tax compliance rules. Must be proficient in written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Preferred Level: Hands‑on experience in full fiscal compliance preparation; advanced Excel skills; familiarity with ERP systems and tax compliance solutions; strong analytical and documentation abilities.

title: Part-Time Pharmacist
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Under general supervision, the Part-Time Clinical Research Trials Pharmacist is responsible for interpretation of physician's orders, review of patient therapy, dispensing of appropriate ordered medications and performs all operational duties and evaluations necessary within the inpatient and satellite services.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Interacts in a clinical trial capacity with patients, physicians, other allied health care providers, social services representatives, other immediate clinical staff members, Hospital and University officials and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Interprets medication order for appropriateness of therapy, drug, dose, route, frequency, and duration. Consults with prescriber when clarification is required or makes appropriate therapy and other recommendations as needed.
  • Manages required record-keeping, Investigational Products (IP) study logs, and inventory activities.
  • Oversees administrative accountability associated with the clinical research trials.
  • Maintains records to meet sponsor requirements, FDA regulations and legal requirements for pharmacy operations.
  • Ensures that the prescribed order follows the protocol treatment plan and HUH standard policies and procedures and consults with the principal investigator, co-investigators, and/or research nurses when clarification is required.
  • Reviews orders for investigational agents to ensure that necessary dosage adjustments are made according to the protocol.
  • Monitors patient laboratory indices to ensure conformity with protocol requirements prior to dispensing medications/investigational agents.
  • Reviews patient medication profile for possible drug reactions, duplication of orders and contraindications and consults with physician when clarification is required.
  • Enters patient's medication orders in the standardized pharmacy computer program according to the approved departmental procedures.
  • Ensures that informed consent signed by the subject is on file prior to dispensing medications/investigational agents as required by 21 CFR 50.27.
  • Ensures that accountability records, dispensing documentation, and inventory for all investigational agents are accurate.
  • Progressively monitors inventory level and expiry date and re-order, as necessary.
  • Participates in the preparation of investigational protocol dispensing procedures, drug data sheets, IV worksheets, and physician order forms.
  • Participates in investigational study site visit activities such as audits, pre-qualification visits, site initiation meetings, routine monitoring visits, and site closure visits as applicable.
  • Performs supervision of supportive staff in compounding all parenteral admixtures according to established departmental procedures. Provides directions and guidance in appropriate manners.
  • Performs double checks of supportive staff in compounding of parenteral admixtures, preparation of oral drugs, receipts, and destructions of Investigational Products (IPs), and code carts and hypersensitivity kits.
  • Ensures that proper drug solutions/diluents and volumes are used during drug preparations, and that final products are labeled, and packaged correctly for subjects participating in research protocols.
  • Contributes to clinical trial electronic data capture (EDC) for adverse drug reaction and medication occurrences reporting system.
  • Utilizes computerized controlled drug system in the preparation and distribution of scheduled drugs and complies with all associated record keeping and inventory requirements by DEA.
  • Participates in clinical and quality improvement activities and/or projects within the department and with medical and nursing staff as needed.
  • Participates in general pharmacy meetings, monthly research meetings, pharmacy safety meetings, journal clubs, continuing education presentations, and/or in-services to ensure competency in pharmacy.
  • Understands and able to perform all the essential functions of the research pharmacy technician to ensure the continual operation of the research pharmacy.
  • Sustains professional competence by completing all competence / skills assessment requirements; promotes development through participation in in-services, workshops, seminars, and professional organizations.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are appropriate to the position and area. The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and the natures of the work assigned to this classification and are not to be considered as all inclusive.

Special Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Good communication skills; ability to provide direction to others; ability to work under stress. Ability to perform computerized procedures. Propósito Geral do Papel

Oferece suporte nos Projetos designados para garantir que o projeto seja executado de acordo com os requisitos de qualidade do BMP e Petrobrás. Interage regularmente com representantes de diversos grupos funcionais, incluindo Gerentes de Projetos e time de engenharia do projeto.

Informações Técnicas Adicionais

Desejável conhecimento da ISO 9001. Nivel de inglês que possa promover autonomia na leitura de procedimentos e implantação.

Detalhes em Nível Global

O Especialista de Qualidade será responsável pelo follow-up dos cronogramas de qualidade (Project Quality Schedule), garantindo o cumprimento dos marcos, entregáveis e requisitos mandatórios, bem como pelo monitoramento da aderência aos planos de qualidade, indicadores e auditorias internas e externas.

Adicionalmente, será responsável por garantir a aplicação consistente e rigorosa dos processos, procedimentos e requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade da Worley, atuando de forma proativa na identificação, análise e resolução de problemas de qualidade no dia a dia dos projetos e operações.

Este profissional deverá conduzir propor e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas, assegurando a eliminação das causas dos desvios e a melhoria contínua dos processos. Espera-se atuação próxima às equipes multidisciplinares, com postura consultiva, senso crítico e forte orientação para resultados.

O papel exige rigoroso atendimento aos processos Worley, alto nível de organização, autonomia, capacidade analítica e comunicação eficaz, incluindo a condução de fóruns de lições aprendidas, para suportar decisões.

Qualificações

Diploma universitário, em área relacionada a Qualidade e experiência relevante equivalente. Sólida experiência relevante.

Tomada de Decisão

Atuando sob supervisão mínima, com capacidade de planejar e gerenciar o próprio trabalho, executar tarefas variadas e complexas, identificar problemas e recomendar soluções de forma eficaz.

Atua sob supervisão geral e orientação técnica quando necessário, com interação semanal a mensal. O trabalho não é normalmente supervisionado em detalhe, e o nível de acompanhamento varia de acordo com a complexidade da tarefa. As atividades são atribuídas de forma ampla, geralmente em ciclos mensais, e o trabalho é ocasionalmente revisado quanto à precisão. Há suporte técnico disponível para revisão das entregas e orientação em casos de situações ou requisitos não usuais.

Autoridade de Supervisão

Pode atribuir atividades e fornecer orientação técnica às equipes de engenharia no que se refere aos processos de Qualidade da Worley.

Comunicação

Comunica ideias e conceitos de forma clara e eficaz, conduzindo fóruns de lições aprendidas tanto internamente quanto com o cliente.

Sistemas, Processos e Ferramentas

Sólida compreensão dos sistemas de Qualidade, processos e ferramentas da área, com habilidade para apoiar colegas e resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

Localidade

Rio de Janeiro, RJ

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Dança para o infantil. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas.

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Dança alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Dança;
  • Experiência com infantil;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;

description:
Cuidar também é viabilizar, planejar e transformar.

Somos a Rede Américas, um grupo hospitalar robusto que tem como propósito a Paixão por Cuidar.

Temos um compromisso com a Diversidade!

#CarreiraqueConecta #PaixãoPorCuidar #SouRedeAméricas

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Supervisionar e coordenar as equipes de enfermagem do turno noturno, garantindo a continuidade e a qualidade da assistência prestada aos pacientes;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de protocolos assistenciais, normas institucionais, rotinas operacionais e diretrizes de segurança do paciente;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento da passagem de plantão, identificando riscos assistenciais, pendências e prioridades do turno;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de enfermagem, atuando na resolução de intercorrências clínicas, assistenciais e operacionais;
  • Monitorar indicadores assistenciais e de qualidade (eventos adversos, quedas, lesão por pressão, adesão a protocolos, entre outros);
  • Garantir dimensionamento adequado da equipe, gerenciando ausências, remanejamentos e demandas emergenciais;
  • Atuar como elo entre a equipe assistencial, coordenação/gerência de enfermagem e demais áreas de apoio (médica, hotelaria, farmácia, manutenção, segurança etc.);
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento do Código de Ética de Enfermagem, promovendo postura profissional, respeito e trabalho em equipe;
  • Registrar e comunicar ocorrências relevantes do turno, assegurando rastreabilidade das informações;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Se você quer conquistar os melhores resultados com pessoas que sonham grande, trabalham e crescem juntos(as), nossa área corporativa é o seu lugar.

Para transformar a saúde é preciso:

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem;
  • Experiência prévia em assistência hospitalar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no turno noturno;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança do paciente e rotinas hospitalares;
  • Habilidade para liderança, tomada de decisão e gestão de conflitos;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Nosso cuidado começa dentro de casa, entregando o melhor para as nossas pessoas.

Na Rede Américas, valorizamos quem constrói o cuidado no dia a dia. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios pensados para o seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.

  • Cuidados com a alimentação: Vale-alimentação, vale-refeição ou refeitório no local (de acordo com a unidade);

  • Outros: Vale Transporte, benefícios SESC e programas de reconhecimento.

Só na Rede Américas tem o Programa Bem Cuidar , pautado nos pilares de saúde física, mental e emocional. Nossas linhas de cuidado são pensadas para o bem-estar das nossas pessoas, promovendo hábitos saudáveis, prevenindo doenças e contribuindo para a redução do estresse.

  • Saúde mental e emocional: atendimento e acolhimento psicossocial especializado com psicólogos, psiquiatras e assistente social, de acordo com a necessidade de cuidado de cada pessoa;
  • Assistência social: acolhimento social remoto através de assistente social para demandas de inseguranças financeiras, problemas de saúde, orientações sobre benefícios sociais, dentre outras;
  • Para Gestantes: acompanhamento com equipe multidisciplinar e rodas de conversa mensais;
  • Qualidade de vida : com o TotalPass, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas com condições especiais. Mais saúde e bem-estar para o seu dia a dia;
  • Campanhas de saúde: ações mensais de conscientização com base em dados de gestão de saúde, focadas em prevenção e promoção de hábitos saudáveis.
  • Benefícios sociais: nossas políticas internas promovem mais apoio e bem-estar para quem precisa: pessoas com deficiência, Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), tratamento oncológico e gestantes.

*Os benefícios podem sofrer alterações de acordo com a região da vaga e da marca.

Se o cuidado também é a sua paixão, aqui é o seu lugar. Candidate-se e construa uma carreira que conecta propósito e prática.

Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo Do Cargo

Atuar como agente de transformação, liderando iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital que impulsionem a competitividade, a eficiência operacional e a experiência do cliente. Esta posição tem como propósito fortalecer uma cultura de inovação contínua, conectando tendências emergentes às necessidades estratégicas da Supergasbras e promovendo soluções que gerem valor sustentável para o negócio .

Responsabilidades

  • Mapeamento de Tendências e Tecnologias: Mapear e analisar tendências, tecnologias e inovações com potencial de impacto, antecipando oportunidades, orientando decisões estratégicas e solucionando desafios complexos da organização.
  • Processos de Discovery: Conduzir processos estruturados de discovery para identificar desafios relevantes, compreender as necessidades dos usuários e propor soluções inovadoras com base em metodologias inovadoras como Design Thinking, Service Design, Lean Startup, Agile e outras.
  • Parcerias Estratégicas: Apoiar na construção e manutenção de parcerias com startups, universidades, fornecedores, clientes e unidades de negócio.
  • Prototipagem e Experimentação: Facilitar a colaboração entre equipes multidisciplinares para desenvolver, testar e iterar rapidamente protótipos, provas de conceito e MVPs, garantindo agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.
  • Capacitação e Disseminação de Conhecimento: Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e outras ações de capacitação para disseminar metodologias de inovação e fomentar o pensamento criativo em toda a organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiencia na área;
  • Conhecimentos do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês avançado

Requisitos Diferenciais

  • Desejável especialização, pós ou mestrado em gestão, inovação ou tempo de experiência em cadeiras que necessitem do domínio em técnicas de design thinking, lean-startups e/ou metodologias de gestão ágil de projetos;
  • Experiência em start-up, consultoria em Inovação ou em áreas de Inovação em grandes empresas, principalmente do setor varejista e de bens de consumo (capacidade de execução e entrega em ciclos mais curtos).

O que faz a gente ser Super?

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

E o que nós fazemos exatamente?

Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.

What’s The Role

  • Technology Theme Development and Assessment
  • Oversight and management of budget expenditure for projects delivered under his/her responsibility, guaranteeing the Levy compliance.

  • Relationship Management
  • Identify appropriate stakeholders and engage/manage relationship(s) at appropriate level. This extends to other oil and gas companies, Universities, State and Federal Research Councils, Regulatory authorities e.g. ANP, CNPq etc.
  • Manage project relationships to ensure appropriate oversight of the projects, identify and maintain engagement in the programmes from the participants and promote integration between work streams towards a common goal.
  • General
  • Maintain surveillance of the wider technology arena, and track developments, competitor and supplier activity with potential relevance to the Low‑Carbon Tech agenda: attend relevant industry conferences, develop networks of contacts etc.
  • Communicate effectively at all levels, both internally and externally: share knowledge with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Ecology, Agronomy and related areas (MSc degree is desirable)
  • 3+ years of experience in related field
  • Solid knowledge in Project Management
  • Technical and analytical knowledge in research and development, particularly in carbon projects and Life Cycle Analysis
  • The ability to work productively with a range of personnel and disciplines, both within Technical and the business and both technical and non‑technical
  • Fluent in both written and spoken Portuguese and English is essential
  • Good interpersonal and relationship building skills, with the ability to interact effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Must be a good written and verbal communicator, able to present and summarise issues concisely
  • Must be a clear thinker, able to assimilate and analyse a wide range of information and generate pragmatic solutions
  • Ability to influence key internal and external stakeholders

What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

description:
Quem somos

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas a vendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Dados com perfil analítico e consultivo, capaz de transformar dados em insights acionáveis e em histórias claras e relevantes para clientes.

Essa pessoa terá papel central na leitura de resultados de campanhas, construção de análises em BI e desenvolvimento de materiais visuais que apoiem decisões, mostrem valor e aumentem o engajamento dos clientes com a estratégia da Incentive.me. Mais do que “operar dados”, queremos alguém que saiba interpretar contexto, identificar padrões, gerar recomendações e comunicar bem. Possibilidade de crescimento para coordenador se atender às expectativas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar bases de dados de campanhas e programas de incentivo para identificar padrões, oportunidades, desvios e alavancas de resultado.
  • Transformar dados em insights claros e acionáveis, com foco em performance comercial e comportamento da força de vendas.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards e visuais em ferramentas de BI (Power BI).
  • Interpretar indicadores e métricas de negócio (ex.: adesão, engajamento, performance, conversão, CAV, ROP, etc.) e traduzir isso em recomendações práticas.
  • Criar narrativas analíticas (“data storytelling”) para apresentações, relatórios executivos e reuniões com clientes.
  • Apoiar times internos (atendimento, community, operação e estratégia) com análises que direcionem decisões e priorizações.
  • Garantir consistência e qualidade das análises, validando dados e sinalizando possíveis inconsistências.
  • Estruturar relatórios recorrentes e análises para acompanhamento de campanhas.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes quando necessário, ajudando a explicar resultados e responder dúvidas com segurança analítica.
  • Documentar principais métricas, premissas e leituras para dar escala e consistência às análises.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com análise de dados aplicada a negócio (BI, performance, marketing, comercial ou áreas correlatas).
  • Domínio de SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade de construir dashboards claros, objetivos e visualmente organizados.
  • Boa capacidade de interpretação de métricas e leitura crítica de resultados.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa interação com times multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com campanhas de incentivo, trade marketing, varejo ou força de vendas.
  • Conhecimento em Python para análises complementares e automações.
  • Vivência com apresentação de resultados para clientes ou áreas de negócio.
  • Noções de estatística aplicada e testes simples (comparativos, tendências, coortes etc.).
  • Habilidade de comunicação para transformar análise em narrativa (oral e escrita).

O que oferecemos?

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

About The Job

At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting‑edge AI models. Identity sits at the core of most modern security failures, and we’re looking for people who understand how and why identity systems break in real environments. You will work with realistic identity and access scenarios to help ensure AI systems learn how IAM risk actually emerges and propagates.

Position: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst
Type: Contract / Task-Based
Compensation: $35–$60 /hour
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze IAM, SSO, and access control scenarios to identify weaknesses and misconfigurations
  • Classify permission issues, privilege escalation paths, and identity‑related failures
  • Review zero‑trust models and access design decisions
  • Help generate and validate realistic identity security data used to train and evaluate AI systems

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years working with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms
  • Familiarity with RBAC, least‑privilege models, and access review processes
  • Understanding of how identity failures occur and how attackers exploit them

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Work directly on frontier AI systems.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.

title: Advanced Fuels Project Lead
description:
What’s The Role

The Advanced Fuels Project Lead will be responsible for conducting end‑to‑end techno‑economic assessments across a portfolio of low‑carbon fuel pathways, from early conceptual definition and process modelling through to economic evaluation and decision‑support for business stakeholders. The role requires close collaboration with researchers, process engineers, technology developers, and commercial teams to ensure technical quality, coherence of assumptions, and transparent translation of results into Shell’s strategic options. The selected candidate will engage with internal Shell Experts to validate methodologies. The successful candidate will typically oversee and contribute to 6–10 technology projects.

  • Technology Theme Development and Assessment
  • Oversight and management of budget expenditure for projects delivered under his/her responsibility, guaranteeing the Levy compliance.
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify key technology themes of strategic importance to the Low‑Carbon Fuels (LCF) business and which can be developed through externally funded R&D projects.
  • Plan, facilitate and participate in technology workshops and other stakeholder events to develop an in‑depth understanding of the technology challenges and opportunities facing LCF and potential routes to solutions.
  • Lead Techno‑Economic Assessments (TEA) for emerging and advanced fuel pathways, including SAF, green/renewable diesel, hydrogen, e‑fuels, and biomass‑derived intermediates.
  • Develop and optimise detailed process models in Aspen Tech (or similar simulators), ensuring robust mass & energy balances and rigorous thermodynamic property selection.
  • Translate process simulation outputs into scalable cost models, including CAPEX, OPEX, sensitivity analyses, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Assess feedstock‑to‑fuel pathways, identifying technical bottlenecks, scale‑up barriers, integration opportunities, and overall commercial viability.
  • Benchmark novel technologies against conventional processes to support go/no‑go decisions, portfolio prioritisation, and strategic roadmaps.
  • Proposal Management
  • Align the projects under his/her responsibility with third parties with Shell Strategy.
  • Develop and make recommendations with respect to optimisation of its portfolio through value analysis, maximising R&D levy qualification and value delivered, building relationships with strategic partners, creating value for Shell and guaranteeing the real translation of the benefits to the company.
  • In conjunction with internal and external stakeholders review and rank project proposals in line with the Low‑Carbon Energy Programme strategic requirements, with particular focus on the assessment of business value to Shell and project risk management and mitigation.
  • Liaise with potential partners to ensure a common understanding of the technologies to be developed and provide technical support to the development of cooperation agreements to the strategic benefit of Shell.
  • Undertake the necessary due diligence and develop the necessary materials to take projects through the appropriate internal sanction process and provide the required technical and project management input to the finalisation of contracts with supplier(s).
  • Project Management
  • Provide project management expertise to ensure effective and timely delivery of Technology projects.
  • Set, agree and monitor performance standards for projects ensuring compliance especially HSSE and Ethics & Compliance standards/policies relevant to the R&D activities undertaken by suppliers and Universities.
  • Work closely with the developers and other funders to ensure that the sponsors' requirements are being met and if required, provide project management support to the developer team: meet with the developers on a regular basis to ensure that targets are being achieved and give project direction.
  • Ensure that projects are professionally managed and are driven to deliver the agreed outputs within budget, interfacing with Shell technical experts and assets as required.
  • Progress projects in the Technology maturation tollgates.
  • Relationship Management
  • Identify appropriate stakeholders and engage/manage relationships at appropriate level. This extends to other oil and gas companies, Universities, State and Federal Research Councils, Regulatory authorities e.g. ANP, CNPq etc.
  • Manage project relationships to ensure appropriate oversight of the projects, identify and maintain engagement in the programmes from the participants and promote integration between work streams towards a common goal.
  • General
  • Maintain surveillance of the wider technology arena, and track developments, competitor and supplier activity with potential relevance to the Low‑Carbon Tech agenda: attend relevant industry conferences, develop networks of contacts etc.
  • Communicate effectively at all levels, both internally and externally: share knowledge with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering is required (PhD degree is desirable).
  • 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • Technical and analytical expertise in research and development.
  • Strong expertise in Aspen Tech (steady‑state modelling, reactors, separation trains, property methods).
  • Proven experience conducting TEA for energy, fuels, or chemical processes, including cost estimation methodologies (estimates, equipment sizing, scaling laws).
  • Deep knowledge of process engineering principles, reaction systems, heat/mass transfer, and process integration.
  • Familiarity with advanced fuel technologies such as HEFA, FT‑SAF, ATJ, gasification routes, e‑methanol, green hydrogen, ammonia, or similar.
  • Ability to connect technical insights to economic, sustainability, and commercial outcomes.
  • Solid knowledge in Project Management.
  • The ability to work productively with a range of personnel and disciplines, both within Technical and the assets and both technical and non‑technical.
  • Fluent in both written and spoken Portuguese and English is essential.
  • Good interpersonal and relationship building skills, with the ability to interact effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
  • Must be a good written and verbal communicator, able to present and summarise issues concisely.
  • Must be a clear thinker, able to assimilate and analyse a wide range of information and generate pragmatic solutions.
  • Ability to influence key internal and external stakeholders.
  • This role requires frequent travel, estimated at approximately 25 %.

What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we’re working towards that goal.

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our Approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our Values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Lead Portfolio Manager to join the Portfolio Management Department (PMD).

The Portfolio Management Dept (PMD) serves as a centralized ownership and capital stewardship function for Saudi Aramco’s diversification investments and joint ventures.

Your primary role will be acts as the designated shareholder representative across assigned portfolio companies and is responsible for post-investment value realization, governance oversight, capital efficiency improvement, and performance accountability.

Key Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Continuously assess portfolio company performance against original investment thesis.
  • Identify thesis erosion risks and recommend strategic realignment where necessary.
  • Provide structured shareholder-level perspective on long-term strategic positioning.
  • Develop and implement structured Value Creation Plans (VCPs) following investment close.
  • Establish measurable financial and operational targets (EBITDA growth, ROACE improvement, cash generation, working capital efficiency).
  • Monitor implementation rigor and quantify value capture.
  • Lead periodic value realization reviews.
  • Review reinvestment proposals and capital allocation decisions at portfolio company level.
  • Evaluate liquidity, leverage, covenant compliance, and refinancing risk.
  • Assess capital efficiency relative to Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) and shareholder return expectations.
  • Recommend capital structure optimization initiatives.
  • Assess governance effectiveness, including Board and sub-committee structure.
  • Support Aramco-nominated Directors with analytical pre-briefs and recommendations in advance of meetings.
  • Ensure reporting transparency and alignment with Aramco governance standards.
  • Promote disciplined decision-making at Board level.
  • Monitor variance against approved budgets and long-range plans.
  • Identify emerging operational or financial risks.
  • Recommend structured corrective actions and elevate material risks to the CIO where appropriate.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive positioning, and macroeconomic developments.
  • Translate market developments into shareholder-level implications.
  • Identify growth, consolidation, or restructuring opportunities within the portfolio.

Qualifications

As a successful candidate, you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited university. An Advanced degree is preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Private Equity, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Direct Industrial Investments, Consultants with experience of designing and implementing value creation plans and turnaround plans, and Investment Banking (restructuring / industrial sector coverage)
  • Experience in the Middle East or in emerging markets more broadly is a plus.
  • Be able to fully relocate to Saudi Arabia as an expat.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 Driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox.

Role Overview

Brookhaven is one of the largest experiences on Roblox, with millions of players jumping in every day. At Voldex, we’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the next chapter of the game — from new features and gameplay systems to technical improvements that keep the experience polished, scalable, and fun. ✨ You’ll collaborate closely with designers, artists, and producers, write clean and maintainable Roblox Lua code, and ship updates that reach a massive global player base. If you’re excited by live games, fast iteration, and the opportunity to make an impact on a title played by millions, this could be a great fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and launch features that delight millions of players daily
  • Write clean, performant, and maintainable Roblox Lua code
  • Partner closely with designers, artists, and producers to craft compelling gameplay experiences
  • Debug, optimize, and improve live game systems
  • Elevate the technical quality and performance of our games
  • Playtest regularly and provide thoughtful design and product feedback

Who You Are

  • Strong foundation in CS fundamentals and problem-solving
  • Familiarity with game engines, scripting languages, version control
  • Excellent communication and collaborative mindset
  • 2+ years of Roblox development experience

Nice to Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in CS/Software Engineering or equivalent development experience
  • Experience working in game teams
  • Shipped games or features on Roblox or similar platforms
  • Game jam or modding experience
  • Familiarity with live game systems (analytics, economy tuning, balancing)
  • 2+ years professional software development experience

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Lua scripting
  • Analytics pipelines (Snowflake, Tableau)
  • Collaboration tools: GitHub, Discord

Location

  • Remote / Timezone: must be willing to work EST/PST hours
  • Travel: 2 to 3x / year (onboarding, RDC + possible team meet-ups)
  • Hiring Regions: Canada, UK, LATAM

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status

Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:

  • Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • ⛳️ Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Analyst focused on Employee Communications, you will drive how engagement is measured and optimized across digital channels, turning data into actionable insights that shape messaging and strategy. Leveraging GA4, SQL, and BI tools like Looker Studio or Tableau, you’ll uncover patterns, support experimentation, and enable stakeholders to make data-informed decisions. This role offers strong visibility and impact at the intersection of analytics, internal communications, and digital platforms.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and maintain the measurement framework for Employee Communications, including KPIs, north-star metrics, and leading indicators;
  • Implement and QA GA4 tracking for internal websites, newsletters, and campaign landing pages;
  • Build automated dashboards and self-serve reporting in Looker Studio or Tableau for stakeholders at different levels;
  • Analyze traffic, engagement, and content performance across communication channels;
  • Segment performance by audience, geography, organization, device, and channel to identify drivers of awareness and action;
  • Run experiments and A/B tests on content, timing, and channel mix; measure results and recommend optimizations;
  • Develop attribution approaches for internal campaigns;
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and documentation, including event taxonomies, UTM standards, metadata conventions, and metric definitions;
  • Collaborate on campaign execution by supporting targeted list pulls and data segmentation to improve message relevance and engagement rates;
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to support leadership requests and quarterly or annual business reviews;
  • Translate analytical findings into clear narratives and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience in digital, marketing, or product analytics, or similar analytical roles;
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and joining datasets across multiple data sources;
  • Hands‑on experience with Google Analytics 4 , including events, parameters, custom dimensions/metrics, conversions, and explorations;
  • Experience implementing and validating analytics tracking frameworks, including tagging plans, UTM standards, and metadata governance;
  • Advanced experience building dashboards in Looker Studio and/or Tableau , including data modeling, calculated fields, filters, and interactive visualizations;
  • Strong data modeling and data preparation skills;
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations;
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Experience analyzing engagement and performance metrics across digital channels;
  • Familiarity with survey analytics (e.g., pulse surveys, eNPS) and combining behavioral and attitudinal data;
  • Exposure to analytics for employee communications platforms (e.g., intranet, email platforms, internal messaging tools);
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience designing advanced data visualizations in Tableau;
  • Experience with Python for exploratory analysis or data manipulation.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising:
  • Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in
  • judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development:
  • Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management:
  • Develop and manage programs that increase students' and graduates' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.

  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.
  • Diversity and Inclusion:
  • Advocate for and support underrepresented students in pursuing clerkships and public interest careers, ensuring they have access to resources and opportunities.
  • Develop initiatives to increase diversity within judicial clerkships, including partnerships with affinity groups and diversity organizations.
  • Collaboration and Leadership:
  • Work closely with faculty, administration, and other career services staff to integrate clerkship advising across the curriculum.
  • Represent the law school at regional and national conferences focused on judicial clerkships and relevant public interest areas.
  • Stay informed of trends and developments in judicial clerkships to provide the most current and relevant advice to students and alumni.
  • Develop a clerkship advisory committee to assist with clerkship application review and advising.

Core Competencies

title: Salesforce Sales Cloud Developer
description:
About The Role

At Riveron, a nationally recognized business advisory firm, we combine deep industry knowledge with innovative technology to drive meaningful business outcomes. We’re seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with a strong focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud to join our Technology & Innovation team. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize scalable Salesforce solutions that support sales operations, revenue growth, and go-to-market strategies across the enterprise. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders to translate sales processes into high-performing, secure, and maintainable Salesforce applications.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of hands‑on Salesforce development experience, with deep expertise in Sales Cloud.
  • You are highly proficient in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL.
  • You have designed and implemented Sales Cloud data models, including Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Forecasting.
  • You have experience building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and middleware tools such as MuleSoft.
  • You have a strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field‑level security.
  • You are skilled in Salesforce declarative automation tools, including Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and (where applicable) Process Builder.
  • You actively contribute in Agile development environments, participating in sprint planning, estimations, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • You are familiar with CI/CD practices and tools such as Git, Copado, Gearset, and Salesforce DX.
  • You hold a Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (required).
  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and business teams, acting as a trusted advisor for sales‑related solutions.
  • You write clean, scalable, and well‑documented code aligned with Salesforce best practices and long‑term maintainability.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Sales Cloud solutions that support lead‑to‑cash and opportunity management processes.
  • Design and enhance custom objects, Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to meet sales and revenue requirements.
  • Build and optimize functionality related to Leads, Opportunities, Products, Pricing, Quotes, Sales Forecasting, and Pipelines.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable integrations between Salesforce Sales Cloud and external systems (CRM, ERP, finance, and marketing platforms).
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate sales strategies into effective technical solutions.
  • Automate and streamline sales workflows using Flows and Apex, ensuring performance and governor limit compliance.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with Salesforce best practices.
  • Support DevOps and deployment activities, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to sales users.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, solution design artifacts, and knowledge sharing within the development team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Salesforce Administrator, or App Builder.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or advanced pricing and quoting solutions.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and dashboards to support sales performance insights.
  • Experience working with multi‑region or global sales organizations.
  • Exposure to Salesforce integration patterns and enterprise‑scale implementations.
  • Prior experience mentoring junior developers or leading technical initiatives.
  • Background in professional services, consulting, or enterprise transformation projects.

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high‑growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client‑centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well‑being in and out of the office.

title: Ubuntu Security Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is building a team dedicated to providing security coverage across a wide range of ecosystems and environments, working to make the world a better, safer place. We are hiring an Ubuntu Security Engineer to join an industry‑leading security engineering team and help protect the open source community and Ubuntu users from emerging threats. We are looking for candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior.

As part of the Ubuntu Security Team, you will work with some of the best and brightest people in technology to monitor, triage, respond to, and document new and existing vulnerabilities in open source software. You will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify issues, prioritize them, and coordinate remediation.

This is an engineering‑focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.

This role requires international travel at least twice a year, usually for one week. It also requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self‑discipline and self‑motivation.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzing, fixing, and testing vulnerabilities in open source packages
  • Keeping track of vulnerabilities in the Ubuntu ecosystem as they are discovered, researched, and fixed, leveraging internal tools
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu community and upstream developers, as needed, to exchange or develop vulnerability patches and ensure that Ubuntu includes the most robust security features
  • Auditing source code for vulnerabilities
  • Building features and tools to help teams strengthen the security of their products and contribute to the overall security of Ubuntu

Qualifications

  • You have a thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and techniques for fixing them
  • You are familiar with coordinated disclosure practices
  • You are familiar with open source development tools and methodologies
  • You are skilled in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • You have excellent logic, problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and decision‑making skills
  • You can clearly and effectively communicate with the team and Ubuntu community members

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio das suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!
